newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: TransAsia hikes share par value to one peso.
newsitem.headline: TransAsia hikes share par value to one peso.

text.p: TransAsia Oil & Energy Development Corp said on Wednesday its board of directors had approved a resolution to increase the par value of its shares to one peso per share from the present one centavo.
The price change is to be approved by its shareholders at their annual meeting on January 7 next year.
TransAsia closed at 1.2 centavos on Wednesday, 0.1 centavo lower than the previous day's close.
